name: David Chura
office: City of Rancho Palos Verdes, Member of the City Council

items.text: David Chura is CEO of enclayve Group and a former Rancho Palos Verdes planning commissioner. His campaign says he served on the commission six years, two as chair. He says he previously held leadership roles at Northrop Grumman. During the pandemic, he created the Safe Queue app to help businesses manage lines, earning council recognition.

sentences.text: David Chura is CEO of enclayve Group and a former Rancho Palos Verdes planning commissioner.
His campaign says he served on the commission six years, two as chair.
He says he previously held leadership roles at Northrop Grumman.
During the pandemic, he created the Safe Queue app to help businesses manage lines, earning council recognition.

items.text: Chura calls the Portuguese Bend landslide a fiscal challenge that consumed city reserves and nearly half the budget. He supports Measure RS, a proposed tax on visitors. He says the city must seek county, state and federal disaster funds. In 2024, he called high-density housing a public safety issue due to fire risk. His other priorities include public safety, wireless networks and road repairs.
